authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10158 mukha explicitly gives mouth/face, Prakrit muha, Lahnda/Punjabi mũ(h), Maiya mũ, Bengali mu and Oriya muhã; it also documents mui/mūī face forms. Selected mṳ̃/mhū̃/mũ./mũə/məh retain breathiness, nasalization, vowel and h placement, while western mvi/moi retain the glide/final-i shape as a regional qualification. These are short-form family links, not source-spelling corrections; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: mṳ̃.
